features: FITS KINDLE PAPERWHITE (2021-2026), SIGNATURE EDITION, COLORSOFT & KOBO AURA H2O: Compatible with Paperwhite, Signature Edition and Colorsoft 6.8" to 7" models (2021-2026) plus the Kobo Aura H2O. Please check sizing information carefully before purchasing.

READ LONGER IN COMFORT: Ergonomic straps that ease wrist strain and finger fatigue, so you can enjoy reading for hours. Unlike bulky cases, our straps secure your Kindle to your hand - no more tight grips or device drops!

TWO STRAPS. TOTAL CONTROL: Includes 2 straps for left or right-hand use, or wear both for added corner protection. Switch hands easily while reading, with better balance, stability and a confident hold.

PREMIUM SILICONE THAT HOLDS ITS SHAPE: Made from high grade, tear resistant silicone that maintains ideal tension and comfort even with daily use. This Kindle strap stays secure without stretching out over time.

CLEVER ALTERNATIVE TO A CASE: Lightweight, low-profile design adds grip and corner protection without the bulk of a case. This Kindle accessory hand strap secures comfortably to your hand while keeping your device light and unobstructed.

EASY TO ATTACH IN SECONDS: Each strap is clearly labelled TOP LEFT or TOP RIGHT. With your e-reader facing you, match the labelled corner, then stretch diagonally to the opposite bottom corner for a secure fit.
description: Elevate the way you read with Strapsicle. Our slim, ergonomic hand straps for Kindle and e-readers that gives you secure one handed control without the bulk of a traditional case. Designed for e-readers who want freedom, comfort and a steady grip, Strapsicle is the ideal Kindle accessory for reading in bed, relaxing on the couch, commuting or traveling. Each pack includes two straps, one for left-handed use and one for right-handed use, allowing you to choose the hold that feels most natural. You can also wear both straps together for added corner protection and stability. Attaching them takes seconds. With your e reader facing you, simply match the labelled strap to the correct corner, then stretch it diagonally to secure the opposite edge. No tools, adhesives or setup complications. These straps fit the Kindle Paperwhite and Colorsoft 6.8-to-7-inch models from 2021 to 2024, as well as the Kobo Aura HD. Please review the sizing information carefully to ensure you choose the right straps and get the perfect fit for your device.
